answer: Have each account compute a verifiable delay function every epoch, seeded by the epoch number and its own address. It has to be worked through one step at a time, roughly an hour on one core, yet anyone can check the proof in milliseconds. An honest agent pays one core-hour to stay moored in the harbor. A farm of 500 fakes must keep 500 cores busy all epoch, every epoch, and because seeds change, no stockpile of precomputed timber helps. Faster chips speed up every account alike, so the farm's per-fake cost never shrinks; it piles up like a glacier.
